description:
[Items] Full item detail bundle. Everything the item page shows, in one response: `item` (name, description, category, icon, stack size,
despawn seconds, craftable flag), `recipe` (components with quantities), `blueprint_costs` (Research Table scrap
cost, or `default`), `tech_tree` (each tech tree the item is on: `cost` 1 research item - `currency` is the
Blueprint Fragment, Page or Book - and `path_cost`, that item with everything before it on the cheapest route;
`linked` false = in the tree's data but not reachable from its start), `recycle` (rows per `recycler_type`:
`recycler` = monument 50%, `safe_zone` 40%, `powered` = monument with the Power Plant grid at stage 2+ 60%,
`red` 75%; `quantity` with `chance`), `recycle_table` (one row per output with `expected`, `min`, `max` per
type), `vending` (`sold`: NPC shops selling it and the price; `bought`: shops that take it as payment), `repair`, `loot_sources`
(every crate/NPC/barrel that drops it, with `chance_pct` and `amount`, highest chance first), `used_in`
(items this one is an ingredient of), `skins` (the first 24 skins by price, each with `price` and
`store_price` in USD cents, `subscriptions` and `released`), `skins_total` and `similar` (six items from the
same category). Page through all skins with `/items/{shortname}/skins`. Cached for 15 minutes.
name: get_item
title: Full item detail bundle
